presentation.label: Four mute modes
presentation.summary: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
presentation.overview: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
highlights: OT is the default. The global PERSONALIZE setting is stored in battery SRAM; it is not a Part or project setting.
An OS upgrade resets PERSONALIZE. Saving or switching Parts/projects does not make the mode project-specific.
SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR requires its SC_KEY assembly variant so a muted key continues feeding the compressor.
usage: Open PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE and select MUTE MODE.
Choose OTFX to cut the dry signal while delay and reverb tails continue; trigs keep firing underneath.
Mute and unmute an audio track with a long delay or reverb tail, then try OTFX-T to suppress new trigs.
Choose DT-T to let the current voice finish its amp envelope, or OT to restore the stock cut.

resources.recorded: 3 November 2026; authored-source assembly and isolated native-code probes of 0.2.2

storage.label: Authored code and relocated menu tables
storage.conditions: Program bytes 1204 (mm_softmute 996, mm_menu 208; mm_softmute is 1106 beside Sidechain Compressor), tables 204. UNHELD, SHADOW and KEYMASK live inside mm_softmute. This is a standalone source footprint, not a complete common-builder or stock memory inventory. Actual probe stack peaks and model timing are recorded separately.

processing.label: ColdFire native paths
processing.display: Measured model cycles; chip wall-clock pending
processing.conditions: MCF5206E core-cycle model, cache-hit zero-wait; not MCF54455 chip timing. Synthetic stock callbacks exclude their actual work. Conservative V4 code-cycle path bounds exclude cache, bus and interrupt contention; see TESTING.md.

impact.conditions: Source estimate for eight audio tracks; no added DSP program. Complete timing and placement remain pending.

cpu.rationale: Finite ColdFire hook paths with bounded eight-track loops; native paths and stack peaks were measured.

dsp.rationale: No new DSP program; existing voice and FX dispatch is retained.

memory.rationale: Small authored ROM patches and reused stock state; no new audio buffer allocation.

tests.summary: All three author references match (plain 996 B, SC_KEY 1106 B, menu 208 B). The native probe of this version passes 4,353,132 cases, including the hold after KEY moves away and after MUTE MODE leaves OT; stack peaks are as in 0.2.1. On his MKI (3 November 2026) the author flashed the native card image of Sidechain Compressor and this module (MW_MMOH1) and reported the OT-exit hold, the KEYHOLD checks, an ordinary DT-T mute and a power cycle working; on 27 October the image of this module alone passed every mode, Part and project reload and the timestretch mute check.

conditions.parameterExtremes: All four MUTE MODE values and every eight-bit mute and solo mask with SOLO_FLAG set and clear, plain and SC_KEY variants, and the hold from an OT frame into each soft mode (evidence/probes.json, 4,353,132 executed cases).
conditions.parameterModulation: Not applicable: MUTE MODE is one global PERSONALIZE setting; mute and solo change from the panel or MIDI and are read once per frame.
conditions.modeSwitching: MUTE MODE changed between frames in every order; mutes and solos set and cleared between frames, including the 0->1 edge that issues each track's note-off.
conditions.maxLoad: One instance (a global setting). Per 16-sample block: the frame hook once (at most 3,440, SC_KEY variant in OTFX; 2,176 plain) plus the per-trig hooks for all eight tracks in the same block, 8 x (336 + 336 + 352 + 320 + 304) = 13,184.
conditions.inputConditions: Independent of audio content. Conservative V4 core-path bounds from the actual assembled instructions of this version (16 cycles per ordinary instruction), not chip wall-clock timing; stock callbacks (the note-off and voice routines) are stock cost and excluded.

regions.name: Authored ColdFire code and its RAM bytes, unit mm_softmute (plain; 1,106 bytes beside Sidechain Compressor)
PERSONALIZE menu row code, unit mm_menu
Three PERSONALIZE pointer tables grown from 16 to 17 entries
Six jmp detours written over stock instructions in place
Row-count poke and three ANDY restore length pokes
MUTE MODE setting word (a free PERSONALIZE word) and its battery copy

memory.conditions: From the linked units and the manifest's detours, tables and pokes. UNHELD, SHADOW and KEYMASK are bytes inside mm_softmute (counted there); since 0.2.2 the module keeps no state in stock-owned SRAM. No heap; at most 24 bytes of stack beyond the stock frame routine (evidence/probes.json).

hardware.summary: The author flashed the native card image of Sidechain Compressor and this module with every stock effect kept (MAIN OS d8267756, OS VERSION MW_MMOH1) on his MKI. All passed: a track muted in OT stays silent when MUTE MODE is switched to DT-T, and plays normally when unmuted; an ordinary DT-T mute of a sounding track still lets the note play out; in DT-T, a muted track that rested as a COMPRESSOR's KEY stays silent when KEY moves to another track; MUTE MODE survives a power cycle. The same source passed on that unit as the author's standalone image, its Bugbuild, KYOTI V1.7 and the octabam form (OCTABAM39). Earlier: MW_MMKH1 (KEYHOLD, 3 November) and the image of this module alone (MW_MM022, 27 October) passed every mode, solo, timestretched mutes in OTFX, Part and project reload and a power cycle.
limitations: MKI only; not run on an MKII.
The card image only; the USB package was not run on a unit.
Functional checks; no stress run, frame-interrupt load or chip timing capture.
Beside Sidechain Compressor on the card image; not run beside other modules in this version.
